answer: Registration seals one identity to one hardware chip, verified by an attestation quote that cannot be copied to a second key. A farm of 290 aliases needs 290 physical chips, each costing more than the epoch reward, so the attack is unprofitable before the first answer is even written. The trellis test is the live device, the dawn test is the locked stake, and the onyx test is the graded history no template can fake.
